messages:
alex: Customer reported 502 when updating payment method in the Console. Happens intermittently ~30% of tries. Request id shown on UI: req_9f3b2c. Need HAR + console and a curl repro. Can someone share exact repro steps to pass to the customer?

maria: Thanks Alex. Can you confirm browser + OS? Also ask customer to include the request ID header (x-request-id or x-rw-req) from the failing request.

alex: Customer on Chrome 115 (Mac), also saw it on Safari. They said it succeeds on retry. No more logs attached yet.

maria: Ok — please ask them for: 1) a HAR export (Network), 2) the Console output (preserve log enabled), and 3) a curl of the failing API call if possible. Provide these exact steps: short + copyable. I'll paste instructions.

devon: I'll add a quick curl template they can run locally (they'll need to redact their API key):

```\n# Replace <AUTH> and <REQ_ID>\ncurl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <AUTH>\" \\ \n  -H \"X-Request-Id: <REQ_ID>\" \\ \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\ \n  https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/billing/payment-methods/update \\ \n  -d '{\"payment_method_id\":\"pm_...\",\"billing_contact\":{\"email\":\"you@example.com\"}}'\n```

maria: And here's step-by-step for a clean HAR + console dump in Chrome (Mac):
1) Open Incognito to avoid extensions.
2) Open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I).
3) In Network tab -> check \"Preserve log\".
4) In Console tab -> top-right settings -> check \"Preserve log\" and enable Verbose.
5) Reproduce the flow: Settings -> Billing -> Update payment method -> Submit.
6) After failure, right-click network list -> \"Save all as HAR with content\".
7) Copy console text: three dots -> \"Save as...\" or select all -> copy -> paste into a .txt.
8) Attach both files plus the UI screenshot with the error and the visible Request ID.

raj: For Safari the flow is similar but use Develop -> Show Web Inspector. Network -> right-click -> Export HAR. Ensure \"Preserve Log\" is enabled too.

lee: If they can't run curl, ask them to capture the failing fetch call in the HAR and paste the request headers. We particularly need: Authorization (redact token), x-request-id, host, content-type, and the response status/body.

alex: Good. Also mention to the customer: if the UI shows a Request ID, include that exact string in the reply — we can correlate quickly.

maria: Small troubleshooting tip for support: if request shows 502 with upstream code 504 we should check gateway timeouts in the runtime. If body contains \"connection reset\" or \"empty response\" include that.

ops-bot: Note: Created support ticket #SUP-8421 and attached customer email. Auto-matching logs will search for req_9f3b2c and any similar IDs.

devon: If they can capture HAR, we can generate a reproducible curl from it: open the failing request, right-click -> \"Copy\" -> \"Copy as cURL (bash)\". Ask them to paste that into the reply (redact API key).

maria: Also ask them to disable any local VPN/proxy during repro and to try an incognito window. If they can reproduce in multiple browsers, include both HARs.

alex: I'll send these instructions to the customer now. One more: where should they upload the HAR and logs?

lee: Upload to our secure support upload page (https://support.redwood.ai/upload). If they prefer email, attach as .zip but warn about size limits.

raj: For internal triage, once we have HAR + cURL: 1) grep logs for x-request-id, 2) check gateway metrics around timestamp, 3) check model endpoint health and backend pool for errors.

maria: Thanks — after they upload, tag me and I'll take the backend correlation. If we need a deeper packet capture or runtime traces we'll request a debug bundle from them (we'll give instructions then).

alex: Customer replied with HAR and console attached (uploaded). They included the UI request id: req_9f3b2c, and a cURL (redacted). Files: payment-har.har, console.txt.

devon: I'll try to reproduce locally using their cURL; if it fails I'll run it with --trace to capture TCP hints.

maria: Great. If internal logs show a 502 upstream with a short response body, escalate to eng-runtime with the request id and HAR attached.

ops-bot: Support ticket #SUP-8421 updated with attachments and pinned to oncall.

alex: Closing loop with customer: thanks for the files, we've escalated to backend and will follow up within 4 hours. :thumbsup:
